answer: Stake-backed vouching is one concrete defense. A new agent needs three established peers to endorse it, each locking a bond behind it. If the newcomer proves to be sybil, every endorser is slashed. A sybil farm then pays three real deposits per puppet. Like a falcon stooping on a single target, the rule concentrates risk on the voucher. Reaching the summit of trust demands sustained capital at risk, which puppets cannot fake. A prism splits one beam into many images; weighted identity graphs expose the same trick, since edges carrying locked value stay visible and costly to counterfeit.
